name: foot supported l-sit
description: An L-sit where the heels stay on the floor while the arms lift the hips. It builds the arm lockout and shoulder depression for the full hold.
instructions: Sit with your legs straight in front of you and your hands beside your hips.
Lock your arms and push down to lift your hips off the floor.
Leave your heels resting on the floor.
Press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold, then lower your hips gently.
